source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9.1, printed pages 40-41.

blocks.text: Positive ions tab bante hain jab atoms se electrons nikal jayein. Sodium ion Na⁺ (proton number = 11) mein 10 electrons hain, is liye us ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ hai.
Dhyan dein ke yeh neon ki configuration jaisi hai, jis ke har atom mein 10 electrons hain.
Negative ions tab bante hain jab atoms electrons le lein. Sulfide ion S²⁻ (proton number = 16) mein 18 electrons hain. Us ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ hai, jo argon (18 electrons) jaisi hai.

Aam taur par jab metal atoms positive ion banate hain to bahar wale subshell ke electrons nikalte hain. Magar d-block elements thora alag hain. Periodic table mein potassium se zinc tak 4s subshell 3d se pehle bharta hai, lekin jab d-block element ka atom ion banata hai to 4s ke electrons pehle nikalte hain.

items: Cr³⁺ ion: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d³ (pehle 4s ka ek, phir 3d ke do)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: bharte waqt 4s pehle, nikalte waqt bhi 4s pehle. 4s bahar wala (n = 4) shell hai, is liye ion bante waqt us ke electrons pehle jaate hain.

items: Positive ion: electrons nikalte hain (Na⁺ = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶, neon jaisa); negative ion: electrons aate hain (S²⁻, argon jaisa).
d-block: 4s pehle bharta hai magar ion bante waqt 4s pehle khali hota hai: Ti²⁺ 3d², Cr³⁺ 3d³.
